lessons.title: Non-Fiction: Christmas Traditions Worldwide
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about Christmas traditions in different countries.
success_criteria: I can find a fact about a Christmas tradition.
I can answer a question using the text.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a non-fiction text about Christmas traditions around the world.
lessons.independent_task: Children read an extract and answer retrieval questions.
resources_needed: Non-fiction text about world Christmas traditions
key_questions: What tradition happens in this country?
Where did you find that fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences using text evidence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note non-fiction retrieval skill — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap facts found about world Christmas traditions.
lessons.home_link: Find a fact about a Christmas tradition at home.

lessons.title: Counting in Steps: Christmas Decorations
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count in steps of 2, 5 and 10 using a festive context.
success_criteria: I can count in steps.
I can find a total.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting in steps from Week 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model counting Christmas decorations in steps of 2, 5 and 10.
lessons.independent_task: Children count festive-themed counters in steps, recording totals.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record consolidation of counting in steps — evidence for MATHS.N1.

lessons.title: Where in the World? Christmas Locations
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to locate countries with different Christmas traditions on a world map.
success_criteria: I can find a country on a world map.
I can name a tradition from there.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the continents and world map.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model locating countries with different Christmas traditions (e.g. Australia, Mexico, Japan) on a world map.
lessons.independent_task: Children locate and label countries with their Christmas tradition on a world map outline.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note locational knowledge applied to a cultural context — evidence for GEOG.1.
lessons.home_link: Find a country on a map with your family and discuss its traditions.

lessons.title: Christmas Decorations from Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a decoration inspired by a world tradition.
success_criteria: I can create a decoration.
I can say which tradition inspired it.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of decorations from different countries.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model creating a simple decoration inspired by a world tradition (e.g. Mexican paper flowers, Scandinavian straw ornaments).
lessons.independent_task: Children create their own decoration inspired by a chosen world tradition.

differentiation.greater_depth: Research and replicate a specific tradition in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe craft technique and cultural application — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Display decorations from around the world.
lessons.home_link: Make a decoration inspired by a tradition with your family.

lessons.title: Writing About a World Christmas Tradition
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write factual sentences about a Christmas tradition from another country.
success_criteria: I can write a fact about a tradition.
I can use a capital letter and full stop.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a factual sentence about a world Christmas tradition.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 factual sentences about a chosen tradition.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note factual writing progress — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family a fact about a world Christmas tradition.

lessons.title: Money: Buying Christmas Presents
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve simple money problems involving totals and change.
success_criteria: I can find the total cost of two items.
I can work out change.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving money problems using a present-shopping context.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve money word problems involving buying presents, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record money problem-solving skill — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise working out cost and change with play money.

lessons.title: Christmas in Hot and Cold Countries
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how climate affects Christmas celebrations.
success_criteria: I can describe Christmas in a hot country.
I can describe Christmas in a cold country.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how Christmas differs in hot countries (e.g. Australia, beach Christmas) vs cold countries (snowy Christmas).
lessons.independent_task: Children compare Christmas celebrations in a hot and cold country, recording differences.
key_questions: What is Christmas like in a hot country?
How is it different in a cold country?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note climate's effect on culture, a geography/culture crossover — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap Christmas in hot vs cold countries.
lessons.home_link: Discuss what Christmas might be like in a different climate.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Christmas Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read Christmas-themed words.
success_criteria: I can read Christmas words.
I can read a sentence about Christmas.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to Christmas-themed words.
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading Christmas words over the week.

lessons.title: Fractions: Sharing Christmas Treats
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to find fractions of quantities using a festive context.
success_criteria: I can find a half, quarter or third of treats.
I can share fairly.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model finding fractions of festive treat quantities.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve fraction problems using a festive treats context.
key_questions: What is a third of these treats?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record fraction consolidation applied to a festive context — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.home_link: Share treats fairly using fractions at home.

lessons.title: Christmas Foods Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a Christmas food tradition from another country.
success_criteria: I can name a festive food from another country.
I can say what makes it special.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss festive foods from around the world (e.g. KFC in Japan, 13 desserts in France).
lessons.independent_task: Children research/record a Christmas food tradition from another country.
key_questions: What food is eaten here at Christmas?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give reasoning for the tradition's origin

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cultural geography understanding — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap Christmas foods from around the world.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your family's festive food traditions.

lessons.title: Sharing Christmas Traditions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to share their own family traditions respectfully.
success_criteria: I can share a family tradition.
I can listen respectfully to others' traditions.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's learning about world traditions.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss respecting and being interested in others' different traditions.
lessons.independent_task: Children share a family tradition (Christmas or otherwise) with a small group.
key_questions: What tradition does your family have?
What did you learn about a friend's tradition?

differentiation.greater_depth: Share unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and respectful engagement with diversity — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the range of traditions shared.
lessons.home_link: Talk more about your family's traditions.

lessons.title: Christmas Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve mixed word problems using a festive context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies to 100.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a festive context (e.g. cards sent/received).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve Christmas-themed word problems within 100, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a festive word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Our Christmas Around the World Map
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to synthesise the week's locational knowledge onto a class map.
success_criteria: I can add a country to the class map.
I can add one fact about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all countries studied this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss contributing to a large class world map display.
lessons.independent_task: Children add their researched country and fact to a large class 'Christmas Around the World' map.

differentiation.greater_depth: Add detailed facts and help others place their countries

lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's locational knowledge — evidence for GEOG.1.
lessons.plenary: Admire the completed class world map.
lessons.home_link: Show the class Christmas world map idea to your family (describe it).

lessons.title: Christmas Around the World Quiz
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about world Christmas traditions.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about world Christmas traditions, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What tradition happens in this country?
Why might traditions differ by climate?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on world Christmas traditions.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Fractions, Money, Number
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply fractions, money and number skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can find fractions of quantities.
I can solve money problems.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of fractions, money and word problems.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 3 stations covering each skill.
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 13 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.N2/N4/MEA.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising fractions and money over the break.

lessons.title: Christmas Around the World Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to contribute art to a collaborative world Christmas display.
success_criteria: I can add my decoration to the display.
I can talk about its cultural inspiration.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss arranging decorations into a collaborative class display representing world traditions.
lessons.independent_task: Children help arrange their decorations into a class 'Christmas Around the World' display.

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the display's cultural range to visitors

lessons.assessment_notes: Note collaborative art and cultural understanding across the week — evidence for ART.1/GEOG.1.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of the Christmas Around the World display.
lessons.home_link: Describe the class display to your family.
